## Order on delivery of the records

The applicant, *⟦ORG|Pellam* *Industries Inc⟧*, seeks delivery of the records held by **⟦ORG|Rooke & Venn** **Groundworks Ltd⟧**. The delivery obligation also applies to ⟦ORG|Quillon** **Freight Media⟧, which trades under that name.

The first delivery address is **⟦ADDRESS|4410 Quarry Street** **Brindlecombe, CA 95999⟧**. The second delivery address is ⟦ADDRESS|4300 South 26<sup>th</sup> Street, Slocombe, Pennsylvania 19999⟧.

Electronic copies must be sent to ⟦EMAIL|records@pellam.invalid⟧. The parties must retain an inventory of every delivered file.

The deadline is 14 January 2027. Section 5.1 and schedule 4 govern the form of the inventory. This order determines delivery only and reserves all questions of costs.
